# Version 4.154.0 (Unreleased)
> **failed-flush cache fix**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 fixes stale Ganesh cache entries after failed GPU flushes.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Failed GPU flushes no longer leave stale cache entries** — Updates the bundled Skia renderer to discard stale Ganesh cache state after a flush failure, improving recovery for GPU-backed rendering. ([#5253](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5253))
